name: CVE Triage & Remediation
description: Look up a CVE, assess real-world exploitability, and produce a prioritised remediation plan with SIEM detection queries.
author: PortableLM

steps.prompt:
Based on this vulnerability analysis:
{{analysis}}

Produce a full remediation plan:
1) Immediate actions (0-24h) — workarounds, WAF rules, firewall blocks
2) Short-term mitigations (1-7 days)
3) Long-term fix — patch/upgrade path
4) Detection queries:
   - Splunk SPL
   - Elastic KQL
   - Microsoft Sentinel KQL
5) YARA rule if file-based indicators exist
6) Sigma rule for network/endpoint detection
7) Priority rating: Critical/High/Medium/Low with justification
